title: Design System: Course Digital Twin Professor Workspace

body.purpose: Interview content, descriptions, and review records.

label.purpose: Navigation state and concise metadata in sentence case.

shadows.name: composer
shadows.purpose: Conversation composer and temporary overlay panels only.

motion.name: state-fast
motion.purpose: Navigation, hover, focus, and disclosure feedback.

components.name: Primary Action
components.description: One decisive professor action in the active tool.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background:#202123; color:#fff; border:1px solid #202123; border-radius:8px; padding:8px 14px; font:600 14px/1.4 'Geist Variable',system-ui,sans-serif; transition:background 150ms cubic-bezier(.2,0,0,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:#343438; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #5b5bd6; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Workspace Navigation Item
components.description: Selected stage in the quiet professor-workspace sidebar.
components.css: .ds-nav { width:220px; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:8px; background:#f0f0f2; color:#202123; border:0; border-radius:8px; padding:8px 10px; font:550 14px/1.4 'Geist Variable',system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-nav:hover { background:#e8e8eb; } .ds-nav:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #5b5bd6; outline-offset:2px; } .ds-nav small { color:#6b6b73; font-size:12px; }

components.name: Conversation Composer
components.description: The elevated prompt area that anchors interview mode.
components.css: .ds-composer { width:620px; display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr auto; gap:10px; align-items:end; background:#fff; border:1px solid #e2e2e6; border-radius:16px; padding:12px; box-shadow:0 8px 30px rgba(32,33,35,.08),0 1px 3px rgba(32,33,35,.08); } .ds-composer:focus-within { border-color:#b8b8ee; box-shadow:0 0 0 2px #eeeeff,0 8px 30px rgba(32,33,35,.08); } .ds-composer textarea { border:0; outline:0; resize:none; font:400 14px/1.5 'Geist Variable',system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-composer button { width:32px; height:32px; border:0; border-radius:8px; background:#202123; color:#fff; }

components.name: Status Chip
components.description: A concise release or stage state with explicit wording.
components.css: .ds-status { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; background:#fff6e5; color:#794300; border:1px solid #f5ca83; border-radius:999px; padding:3px 8px; font:550 12px/1.35 'Geist Variable',system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-status span { width:6px; height:6px; background:#a85d00; border-radius:50%; }

components.name: Context Panel
components.description: Secondary sources, blockers, evidence, and activity beside the active task.

components.css: .ds-context { width:320px; background:#f7f7f8; border-left:1px solid #e2e2e6; padding:16px; color:#202123; font:400 14px/1.5 'Geist Variable',system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-context header { display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; } .ds-context header span { color:#6b6b73; font-size:12px; }

narrative.overview: A mature LLM-style workspace where a professor configures a course tutor through conversation and opens inspectable source, policy, preview, and approval tools without leaving the same working context. The product feels familiar and calm, while professor authority and evidence remain explicit.
keyCharacteristics: Quiet application shell with compact stage navigation.
Centered conversation or structured tool as the primary surface.
Context panel for blockers, evidence, and trace.
Neutral palette with restrained iris focus and semantic states.
Sentence-case product copy and progressive disclosure.

rules.name: The Quiet Shell Rule
rules.body: Navigation supports the work and never becomes the largest visual object on screen.

rules.name: The One Active Signal Rule
rules.body: Iris identifies the current place or focused AI context; it is not scattered across every control.

rules.name: The Human Label Rule
rules.body: Use sentence case; uppercase is reserved for unavoidable stored identifiers.

rules.name: The Floating Composer Rule
rules.body: The composer is the clearest elevated object in conversation mode; routine records do not compete with it.

dos: Do make the interface recognizable as an LLM workspace within seconds.
Do center the current task and keep evidence adjacent.
Do preserve all five real stages and professor approval authority.
Do use progressive disclosure for trace and secondary metadata.
donts: Don't reproduce another product's exact branding or proprietary UI.
Don't lead with metric grids or evaluation-dossier language.
Don't turn every section into a bordered dashboard card.
Don't invent courses, integrations, analytics, or model capabilities.
Don't hide source permissions, blockers, citations, or uncertainty.
